description: In the stipulated material-support plan semantics, every satisfiable theory containing only factual atoms and conditionals has a compatible point permitting all actions. Acceptance of a factual atom and an explicit factual-to-forbidden conditional entails acceptance of the forbidden atom, by the existing general MP result. A nonempty singleton state with an alternative action available accepts the fact but accepts neither the prohibition nor its conditional. This separates conditional plan guidance from categorical normative warrant; neither moral realism nor ordinary-language adequacy is established.
